subject: Dandori Academy
title: What is Dandori Academy? Pikmin 4's new Switch 2 mode
answer: Dandori Academy is a new challenge mode in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy, out Nov. 12, 2026. It adds 72 "Dandori exam" stages that test how efficiently you command your Pikmin, with three difficulty levels, medals and online leaderboards.
body:
"Dandori" is the Pikmin series' word for planning and multitasking, which Nintendo describes as "the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively." Dandori Academy turns that into a series of exams. Gematsu reported that the 72 stages vary in difficulty, earn players in-game medals, and "will be released over time." Nintendo Wire reported that new exams arrive every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and that online leaderboards let players compare scores with friends and strangers.

The Switch 2 Edition also lets players challenge friends in Dandori Battles on the same system, or through GameShare locally or online via GameChat, even if the friend doesn't own the game. Players can give voice commands to Oatchi, the player's dog companion, through the Switch 2 microphone, and the game runs with sharper, higher-resolution visuals in TV and handheld modes.

Yoshiaki Koizumi announced the edition in a Nintendo Direct on Sept. 9, 2026. Owners of the original Switch version can buy a digital upgrade, as with earlier Switch 2 Editions, and a new cartridge contains everything. Prices were not given in those reports.
in_the_news: Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy launches Nov. 12, 2026.

faq.q: How many stages are in Dandori Academy?
faq.a: 72, released over time, across three difficulty levels.

faq.q: When does Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition come out?
What does dandori mean in Pikmin?
faq.a: It is the series' term for planning and commanding your Pikmin efficiently, doing several tasks at once.

faq.q: Can I upgrade my Switch copy of Pikmin 4?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo will sell a digital upgrade for owners of the original Switch version, as with other Switch 2 Editions.

faq.q: Is Dandori Academy on the original Switch?
faq.a: No. It is part of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.
